title: IngestEvent
description: One event of an Ingest stream.

contract_version.description: The version of the contract it speaks, [`CONTRACT_VERSION`](crate::CONTRACT_VERSION).

oneOf.description: One chunk was handled: written, found already stored, or empty.

diff.description:
For a chunk a diff wrote (`reload: "diff"`), what it found of the chunk's rows: the
chunk holds the added and changed ones. Rows staged again for what changed around
them count as changed.

report.description:
The chunk's report as the `ingest` crate writes it (`ingest::ChunkReport`): its
mapping, pass, position, rows and outcome, with what it sent to review. For display
and storage; its shape is not part of the contract.

oneOf.description: A stream whose data the load holds already was skipped, unread (`reload: "diff"`).

snapshot.description: The fingerprint of the data it holds.

stream.description: The stream: its source and mapping, joined by U+001F.

oneOf.description: One page of the sweep of the created entities was checked.
The load ended; the result follows.

RowDiff.description: What a diff found of one chunk's rows, by (row key, row hash), or of one stream's.

added.description: Rows the load didn't hold, staged.

changed.description: Rows the load held with another hash, retracted and staged again.

removed.description: Rows the load held that the source no longer has, retracted.

unchanged.description: Rows the load holds as they are, left alone.
